## Professional experience

### Postdoctoral Researcher — University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus

*July 2025–present · Aurora, Colorado*

- Develop scalable methods for multi-hop retrieval over large biomedical knowledge graphs and integrate retrieved evidence with large language models for clinical applications.
- Develop orchestrator-centered multi-agent systems for clinical prediction, including reinforcement learning for agent selection, role assignment, and stopping decisions.
- Work with clinicians and researchers on systems aligned with diagnostic and clinical decision-support workflows.
